items.note: The prompt says 'a B2B note-taking app'. That matches what they said.
The prompt says the readers are engineering and design leads who will use it at a kickoff meeting.
The prompt lists the in-scope items: creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes.
The prompt says 'Roles: admin and member only.'
The prompt lists the out-of-scope items: billing changes, SSO and guest access.
The prompt gives the metric as 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days and says to use it exactly as written.
The prompt asks for a standard PRD of about 2 pages at most.
The prompt lists the migration of existing shared notes as an open question. It says to leave it unresolved and not to recommend an answer.
